project: Open contextual VPC/VID identification and sense analysis

current_ceiling.permitted_claim: The browser-local human-reviewed workflow is executable and auditable on project-authored fixtures and bounded external development evidence.
current_ceiling.blocked_claim: The project is not yet a validated automatic analyzer, an independently validated benchmark, or an LRE-ready full-length resource.

separation_rules: Each claim belongs to exactly one category in this map.
Each evidence link states the narrow role it supports; sharing a file does not transfer support between constructs.
Software tests establish executable behavior, not linguistic, annotation, user, or population validity.
Dictionary membership establishes candidate inventory evidence, not occurrence, contextual sense, frequency, or learner knowledge.
Downstream coverage, learner-corpus, comprehension, and eye-movement results cannot validate upstream VPC/VID labels.

claims.claim: The method separately represents candidate, occurrence, member, gap, category, idiomaticity, inventory coverage, one or multiple contextual assignment, unresolved alternatives, abstention, unfinished work, semantic out-of-inventory, and inventory ineligibility.
claims.permitted_wording: The executable contract and standalone guide separate the declared review states, and project-authored synthetic checks exercise their machine invariants; independent applicability is not yet established.

current_evidence.supports: The versioned record schema and allowed state transitions.
Round-trip and fixture checks for the executable state contract.

A UI-independent decision order, definitions, examples, contextual-sense source-priority and uncertainty rules, export-state table, evaluation mapping, and synthetic M1–M5 fixture key; no human reliability evidence.

Dependency-free check that every executable state and training fixture is represented in the guide; tokenization, gaps, feature coverage, disagreement codes, field separation, candidate-origin language, and the loss-aware MAGPIE projection are internally consistent.
Twelve project-authored synthetic occurrence/span/category cases with complete gap derivation and first-cause disagreement codes; no human or natural benchmark evidence.
A wholly project-authored, redistributable training/QA bank covers each prespecified hard-case stratum at least twice with admissible routes and rationales rather than benchmark gold.
A synthetic-only staged training protocol fixes separate task gates, critical sentinels, and one failed-task retry; it has not been administered and supplies no qualification evidence.

required_evidence.criterion: After applicable authorization, an unexposed synthetic qualification form and independent pilot show that annotators can distinguish and apply every retained state.

prohibited_inferences: The separated states are linguistically valid because the schema and tests pass.
A confirmed form lookup establishes occurrence, idiomaticity, or contextual sense.

claims.claim: The first technical scope is English VPC.full, VPC.semi, and VID occurrence-and-sense review.
claims.permitted_wording: The planned resource and evaluation concern English VPC.full/VPC.semi/VID only.

current_evidence.supports: The declared primary scope, claim ladder, non-goals, and gate order.
The LRE-facing scope and evidence gaps.
The candidate-independent English VPC/VID inclusion, exclusion, form, span, and taxonomy boundaries.

required_evidence.criterion: The target population and operational category rules are frozen before sampling.

prohibited_inferences: Results generalize to all MWEs, non-verbal idioms, other languages, proficiency, or pedagogical importance.
The repository name expands the study construct.

claims.claim: STREUSLE 5.0 supplies bounded external English VPC/VID occurrence, span, and category development evidence.
claims.permitted_wording: The exposed STREUSLE projection supports a reproducible occurrence/category floor with separately reported continuous/discontinuous and form-seen/unseen strata.

current_evidence.supports: Pinned split metadata, target counts, strata, hashes, and baseline result.
Artifact, rights, construct, and split admission limits.

required_evidence.criterion: New benchmark results use the frozen metrics and sealed split.

prohibited_inferences: The inspected STREUSLE test projection is a blinded project holdout.
STREUSLE supplies fine-grained OEWN sense, literal-negative, representative L2, or general automatic-analyzer validity.

claims.claim: The admitted standard-WSD slice supplies a small external conditional contextual-sense smoke test.
claims.permitted_wording: The 23-row, 18-type exposed VPC slice can test deterministic conditional sense ranking only as a smoke-test floor.

current_evidence.supports: Pinned source artifacts, mapping rules, retained rows, limitations, and exposed split roles.
The decision to admit only a conditional sense smoke test.

required_evidence.criterion: Train-only MFS and deterministic gloss/rule results are reported without blinded or target-wide language.

prohibited_inferences: The slice validates open-text occurrence detection, member spans, VID, take in, unseen forms, or target-wide sense analysis.
The 17 source-test rows are blinded; their labels were inspected during audit.
One retained multi-label row validates ambiguity, abstention, out-of-inventory handling, or calibration.

claims.claim: The hybrid sense-inventory contract, public schema, synthetic lifecycle exercise, full-denominator coverage audit, bounded nonexact queue, VID workflow pilot, and OEWN VPC/VID seed define stable project identities, source mapping, lifecycle rules, uncertainty states, and the present coverage ceiling.
claims.permitted_wording: A versioned pre-annotation design, public Draft 2020-12 schema, hash-fixed synthetic lifecycle exercise, reproducible 146-type VID candidate-review queue, 14-type VID workflow pilot, nine-form/67-candidate OEWN seed, and 624-occurrence coverage audit exist. The seed is available for 57/624 occurrences and 9/389 types, including 21/319 VID and 20/188 discontinuous occurrences, but formal and contextually assessed coverage are 0/624; all contextual-sense claims remain held.

current_evidence.supports: The empty inventory schema, source fingerprint rules, mapping stop, and release constraints.
Aggregate evidence for exact-route coverage and stable-ID limitations.
All 146 exact misses remain in the denominator; the bounded source scan yields three candidate sets and 143 no-route unresolved states.
The frozen source, normalization, review, time, stopping, and non-inference rules.
Four fixed VPC and five fixed VID training/development forms have 67 ID-reserved OEWN candidates with fingerprints, CILI/ILI, licensed wording, and no admitted project senses.

The public Draft 2020-12 structure covers candidate and formal sense records, source links, rights, and explicit lifecycle relation arrays; project tests add registry-wide collision, uniqueness, and update checks that JSON Schema cannot express.

A wholly synthetic, hash-fixed old/new pair exercises split, merge, source deprecation, a training-only OOI-prompted sense, and five non-rewritten migration records without supplying lexical evidence.
The prospective approval, versioning, preservation, manual migration, and post-test branch rules that prohibit performance-driven repair of an exposed benchmark.
The fixed 14-type VID pilot retains exact, slot, nonexact, rights-gated, and no-route states with an explicit unresolved rate and no source text.

All 624 STREUSLE targets, 389 types, and the complete IR-132 pilot remain in the denominator; category, continuity, split, candidate-count, unresolved, and unassessed OOI states show zero formal/contextually assessed coverage and trigger the claim hold.

required_evidence.criterion: The present candidate seed is independently reviewed and adjudicated, with accepted entries moved unchanged into the formal senses layer.

prohibited_inferences: The contract or candidate seed validates contextual assignments or admits a project sense.
Schema validity, collision-free project IDs, or lifecycle fields establish semantic equivalence, split/merge correctness, or independent lexical review.
The synthetic lifecycle exercise is a real lexical adjudication, validates the example meanings, or licenses automatic migration of an old annotation.
Candidate availability for 57/624 occurrences is operational inventory coverage, contextual adequacy, OOI prevalence, or sense accuracy.
OEWN or Wiktionary exact matches alone establish complete target coverage, corpus frequency, or gold senses.
The 143 no-route states prove true lexical or semantic inventory gaps, or may be removed from the denominator.

claims.claim: A substantial independent VPC/VID benchmark can be lawfully obtained or reconstructed by third parties.
claims.permitted_wording: The completed 2026-09-01 English Wikipedia dump identity and reversible preprocessing protocol are frozen for a future namespace-0 sample and CC BY-SA release, but no source content, sample, release bundle, or clean-room benchmark reconstruction exists yet.

current_evidence.supports: The prospectively frozen claim denominators, reporting strata, design weighting, cluster boundaries, and descriptive-only rule for underpowered strata; it contains no result.
The frozen document-level partition, information boundary, independent-custodian requirement, and prohibition on claiming an uninstantiated sealed test.
Known STREUSLE, WSD-slice, and dictionary exposure is explicitly classified as external development or smoke-test evidence.
The documented benchmark-scale, independence, rights, annotation, and comparison gaps.
Current layer-specific rights and external-only restrictions.
The pre-acquisition source choice, official rights basis, target-blind order, release-route comparison, and fail-closed rules.
Current file-level license, notice, redistribution, removal, and future benchmark-layer gates.
The exact completed dated dump metadata plus a project-authored reconstruction probe with stable IDs, offsets, and fail-closed hash checks; no dump content was acquired.
The frozen loss-aware render, prose extraction, paragraph segmentation, tokenization, and source-trace rules before sampling.
The pre-data resource scope, population layers, intended/non-intended uses, release gates, and known limitations.
Language, provenance, population, human-work, bias, distribution, and explicitly unknown release fields.

required_evidence.criterion: A source decision records acquisition, annotation, derivative, redistribution, and persistence rights.
A clean third party can obtain or deterministically reconstruct the released benchmark.

prohibited_inferences: Server-side storage or standoff annotation alone grants redistribution permission.
Current external development resources form a new independent sealed benchmark.
A full-length LRE availability claim is permitted before the release route passes.

claims.claim: The browser-local workflow, exports, and provisional annotation-platform converter execute according to the current software contracts on project-authored fixtures.
claims.permitted_wording: The implemented method hypothesis and synthetic platform-format conversion pass their software contract checks; no live multi-user workflow has passed.

current_evidence.supports: The browser-local candidate review, state editing, resume, and export implementation.
The JavaScript contract and round-trip checks.
Static data, provenance, and audit consistency checks.
The provisional platform choice, frozen custom-layer mapping, independence configuration, and explicit boundary between a synthetic format check and live two-user acceptance.
A standard-library UIMA CAS JSON converter whose synthetic self-test preserves discontinuous gaps, multiple senses, OOI, and conversion audit hashes.

required_evidence.criterion: A clean archived checkout reproduces every released technical result.

prohibited_inferences: Passing software tests validates linguistic decisions, annotation agreement, intended-user interpretation, or real-browser accessibility.
A synthetic UIMA CAS JSON conversion proves live annotator isolation, platform usability, or institutional data-management compliance.
The current implementation is a validated automatic analyzer.

claims.claim: The released workflow has empirically characterized held-out occurrence, span, category, and contextual-sense performance.
claims.permitted_wording: Target-wide technical validity is not yet established; only exposed external floors and smoke tests exist.

current_evidence.supports: The missing independent gold, sealed evaluation, error analysis, and burden evidence.
The current task-specific evidence ceilings.
The pre-data task-specific inputs, formulas, denominators, undefined states, cluster units, conditional calibration/selective metrics, and combined-score prohibition.
Executable point-estimate formulas with legacy supplied-candidate compatibility; not held-out performance evidence.
Synthetic separation and boundary checks for the metric implementation; not linguistic validation.
The fixed-seed document-cluster, canonical-type sensitivity, and paired-resample interval implementation; no observed estimate.
Synthetic reproducibility, overall/stratum reuse, paired comparison, and degenerate-sample checks; not inferential evidence.
The frozen 0.05/0.10 gates, observed-input requirements, resolved planning-pilot route, and no-post-hoc-relaxation rule; no allocation or estimate.
The prospective separation of target-enriched training material from a target-blind probability-sampled planning prefix that is excluded from sealed testing; no pilot rows.
A standard-library candidate-allocation simulator that rejects target-conditioned selection and inactive plans; not a sample-size result.
Synthetic reproducibility, insufficient-cluster, target-conditioned-selection, blocked-plan, and dependency-hash checks; not population evidence.

required_evidence.criterion: Frozen sealed-test results report candidate recall, exact span, category, sense, uncertainty, clustered intervals, and prespecified strata.
Errors and human corrections are separated by construct and stratum.

prohibited_inferences: External exposed floors or synthetic fixtures establish held-out target-wide performance.
An aggregate score can substitute for separate candidate, span, category, idiomaticity, sense, and uncertainty results.

claims.claim: One contextual model assists a named occurrence or sense-ranking task better than the transparent baseline.
claims.permitted_wording: No model-assisted claim is currently authorized; one comparator may be evaluated only after gold, splits, and transparent baselines are frozen.

current_evidence.supports: The conditional single-model rule and omission condition.
The absent model, comparison, calibration, privacy, and deployment evidence.

required_evidence.criterion: One frozen comparator improves a prespecified held-out accuracy, calibration, or review-effort outcome and records rights, compute, latency, privacy, and reproducibility costs.

prohibited_inferences: A model is needed before a measured transparent-baseline deficit exists.
A ranking improvement authorizes unattended automatic truth or a server-side runtime.

claims.claim: Intended L2 vocabulary researchers can operate, resume, interpret, and reproduce the retained workflow without hidden coaching.
claims.permitted_wording: Intended-user usability and interpretation remain untested.

current_evidence.supports: A protocol draft that is explicitly not a publication sample.
The unrun real-browser and intended-user acceptance gates.

required_evidence.criterion: Eligible intended users complete and correctly interpret the frozen tasks with critical errors, time, corrections, unresolved decisions, and qualitative failures reported.
Current Chromium and non-Chromium browsers pass the frozen keyboard, reflow, privacy, and assistive-technology checks.

prohibited_inferences: Developer operation, unit tests, or an optional teach-back protocol establishes intended-user usability.
User agreement with the interface establishes linguistic truth.
Automated accessibility checks alone establish WCAG conformance.

claims.claim: A validated VPC/VID resource can support one separately governed coverage, learner-text, source-corpus, comprehension, or eye-movement application in its sampled domain.
claims.permitted_wording: Downstream work is optional reuse evidence and is not on the core validation path.

current_evidence.supports: The downstream/non-core boundary, archived material work, and one-application limit.
A provisional later eye-movement application candidate without outcome analysis.

required_evidence.criterion: One retained application freezes its own population, outcome, exclusions, rights, model, and prohibited inferences after core validation.
The report stays within the named sample and distinguishes reuse evidence from technical validity.

prohibited_inferences: Coverage, learner-corpus, comprehension, or eye-movement associations validate occurrence boundaries or contextual senses.
Corpus occurrence establishes individual knowledge, learning, comprehension, proficiency, causality, or pedagogical value.
An optional application is required to define the primary technology.
